title: Handover / return workflow
interface:
final class HandoverService. Constructor: __construct(\Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityTypeManagerInterface $entityTypeManager, \Drupal\Core\Config\ConfigFactoryInterface $configFactory, \Drupal\Component\Datetime\TimeInterface $time, \Drupal\hwdesk\Service\HandoverTokens $tokens, \Drupal\hwdesk\Service\ProtocolNumbers $protocolNumbers, \Drupal\hwdesk\Service\ProtocolPdf $protocolPdf, \Drupal\Core\Mail\MailManagerInterface $mailManager, \Drupal\Core\Language\LanguageManagerInterface $languageManager, \Drupal\Core\Datetime\DateFormatterInterface $dateFormatter). Service 'hwdesk.handover' (registered).
Config hwdesk.settings: handover_token_hours (int), base_url (string, may be ''), company_name, protocol_copy_to (e-mail or ''). Now = $time->getRequestTime().
openFor(Asset $asset): ?Handover -- the hwdesk_handover with status 'pending' for this asset (entity query, accessCheck(FALSE)), or NULL.
request(Asset $asset, \Drupal\user\UserInterface $user, \Drupal\hwdesk\HandoverKind $kind, \Drupal\Core\Session\AccountInterface $requestedBy): Handover -- \DomainException when openFor($asset) is not NULL; kind Handover: asset status must be 'in_stock' (else \DomainException); kind ReturnItem: asset status must be 'assigned' and the holder must be $user (else \DomainException). Create hwdesk_handover: asset, user, kind, status 'pending', requested_by => $requestedBy->id(), expires => now + handover_token_hours * 3600; save. Asset: Handover -> status 'pending_handover' and holder = $user; ReturnItem -> status 'pending_return'; save. Mail: key 'handover_request' or 'return_request' to $user->getEmail(); subject contains the asset tag; body (list of lines) contains confirmUrl($handover), the asset display name and tag, and the expiry formatted with $dateFormatter->format($expires, 'custom', 'j. n. Y H:i'). Return the saved handover.
confirmUrl(Handover $handover): string -- token = $tokens->issue((int) $handover->id(), (int) $handover->getUser()->id(), $handover->getExpires()); base = config base_url trimmed of trailing '/'; if base is '' use \Drupal\Core\Url::fromRoute('hwdesk.handover.confirm', ['token' => $token], ['absolute' => TRUE])->toString(); else return base . '/hwdesk/confirm/' . $token.
confirm(Handover $handover, AccountInterface $actor): Handover -- status must be 'pending' (else \DomainException); actor id must equal the handover's user id (else \DomainException); if expires < now: set status 'expired', restore the asset (see below), save both and throw \DomainException. Otherwise: status 'confirmed', decided = now, protocol_number = $protocolNumbers->next(); save; protocol_file = $protocolPdf->store($handover) (set 'protocol_file' => $file->id()); save. Asset: Handover -> status 'assigned' (holder stays $user); ReturnItem -> status 'in_stock', holder NULL; save. Mail key 'protocol' to: the user, the requester's e-mail (if the requester is a user with an e-mail), and protocol_copy_to (if not ''), one message per distinct address; subject contains the protocol number; body contains the protocol number, the asset tag and display name, the user's display name and the URL of the PDF ($file->createFileUrl(FALSE)). Return the handover.
reject(Handover $handover, AccountInterface $actor, string $reason): Handover -- trim($reason) === '' -> \InvalidArgumentException; status must be 'pending' and actor must be the user (else \DomainException). Status 'rejected', decided = now, reason; save; restore the asset; mail key 'rejected' to the requester's e-mail (if any) with the reason in the body and the tag in the subject. Return the handover.
cancel(Handover $handover, AccountInterface $actor): Handover -- status must be 'pending' (else \DomainException); status 'cancelled', decided = now; save; restore the asset; no mail.
expireOverdue(): int -- every hwdesk_handover with status 'pending' and expires < now: status 'expired', decided = now, save, restore the asset; return the count.
Restore the asset (after reject/cancel/expire): Handover kind -> asset status 'in_stock' and holder NULL; ReturnItem kind -> asset status 'assigned' (holder unchanged); save. Always reload the asset through $entityTypeManager->getStorage('hwdesk_asset')->load(...) before changing it so a stale copy is never saved.
Mail: $mailManager->mail('hwdesk', $key, $to, $languageManager->getDefaultLanguage()->getId(), ['subject' => ..., 'body' => [lines...]], NULL, TRUE); hook_mail in hwdesk.module copies subject/body. Keys used: handover_request, return_request, protocol, rejected. Every \DomainException carries a Czech message for the UI. File header: <?php + declare(strict_types=1); namespace Drupal\hwdesk\Service; final class; constructor property promotion with readonly; no \Drupal:: static calls (everything is injected); no other new files.
database: entity storage through the injected EntityTypeManagerInterface
